name: WAA Student Organization Grant
eligibility: Registered UW-Madison student organizations in good standing; funds for programming and events.
description: General-purpose grant supporting student organization programming, events, and member development.

name: UW Office of Sustainability Green Fund
eligibility: Projects advancing campus sustainability; student-led teams preferred.
description: Funds student-led projects that reduce the university's environmental footprint or advance sustainability research and education.

name: Baldwin Wisconsin Idea Endowment
eligibility: Projects extending the Wisconsin Idea — bringing university knowledge to communities beyond campus.
description: Large grant for ambitious community-impact projects that connect UW-Madison expertise with the broader public.

name: ASM Student Org Finance Grant
eligibility: RSOs requesting event or operational funding; segregated-fee rules apply.
description: Standard event and operational funding for registered student organizations.

name: Morgridge Center Community Impact Grant
eligibility: Student groups running community-based service or civic-engagement projects.
description: Supports student projects with direct community benefit, especially service-learning and civic engagement.

name: NSF Data Science Education Micro-Grant
eligibility: Student groups delivering data-science or computational training; broadening-participation focus favored.
description: Micro-grant funding workshops, datathons, and curricula that teach data science and broaden participation in computing.

name: Regional Tech Datathon Sponsorship (2025)
eligibility: Closed cycle — retained for historical reference.
description: Prior-cycle datathon sponsorship, now closed; kept to demonstrate status filtering.
